meta.name: TrainLuma Indian Food DB v1
meta.units: per_100g and per_serving; kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g
meta.licenses: INDB: no license listed (research project; underlying data ICMR-NIN IFCT 2017 govt. data + UK CoFID + USDA) — verify before commercial launch. IFCT values: factual nutrition data via mealPlan.fit (attribute 'Indian Food Composition Tables (ICMR-NIN)'). Kaggle mirror of INDB is CC BY-SA 4.0.
meta.restaurant_mapping_policy: No GTA Indian restaurant publishes nutrition data (verified 2026-10-12). dish_mappings point signature dishes at Tier-1 DB dishes as TYPICAL values only; the app must label them 'typical values — this restaurant's recipe will differ'. Never present as restaurant-verified.
meta.chain_sources: Tim Hortons Nutrition Guide (Canadian Edition, July 2026); McDonald's Canada official product pages/nutrition calculator; Pizza Pizza official medium-pizza nutrition table. All Oct 2026. Osmow's official nutrition calculator (Oct 2026). A&W Canada official site (cal/fat/protein only — Tier 2); KFC Canada W8 PDF; Popeyes Canada 2025 Nutrition Guide; Wendy's Canada menu; Starbucks Canada product page; Mary Brown's July 2026 nutritionals.
